Le 08/11/2014 13:20, Tareef Kawaf a écrit :
Great, thanks Lucasayat,
It isn't so much the hardware management.  The core problem we have to figure out a solution for is how to surface a storage solution that works well across multiple instances and helps provide the correct semantics to write applications with for folks who are likely unfamiliar with the issues you see with distributed systems.

Thanks for your patience and kind words.

-Tareef



On Sat, Nov 8, 2014 at 7:05 AM, jlr <j...@reuillon.org> wrote:
Hi Tareef
Thanks for your feedback... I'll be waiting for a new release fitting with  new R version.
I understand your statement about local storage.... heavy hardware management... but  if one day you find a solution it'll be fine.
All the best and congratulation for the good job.... very helpfull
Lucasayat

Le 08/11/2014 12:30, Tareef Kawaf a écrit :
Hello,
We certainly don't intend to deceive on the issue of local storage. :)

We need a few more days before we roll out support for R 3.1.2.  The easiest thing to do would be to go back to 3.1.1 until we add that support.  

Best,
Tareef
